entities.summary: Second Intifada, a transformative movement in Israel (2000–2009). Emerged from Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin assassinated by an Israeli extremist and Oslo Accords — mutual recognition between Israel and the PLO. Catalyzed Second Intifada and Disengagement and Abraham Accord.
